episodes.name: Truth or Consequences
episodes.overview: As the hunt for Ziva's replacement begins, Gibbs and his remaining team members must head back to work with the past still weighing heavily on their minds.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: The team discovers the bizarre death of a Marine and his two friends may be linked to their past, but it's Gibbs who ends up taking a trip down memory lane.

episodes.name: The Inside Man
episodes.overview: The team must take a second look into the death of a Lieutenant after the blogger who accused them of a cover-up ends up dead.

episodes.name: Good Cop, Bad Cop
episodes.overview: When a Marine's body surfaces halfway around the world, the investigation forces Ziva to dig up a buried chapter of her life.

episodes.name: Code of Conduct
episodes.overview: When a Marine known for his practical jokes is found dead on Halloween Eve, the NCIS team discovers that the victim's "good-natured" pranks may have inspired ghoulish retribution.

episodes.name: Outlaws and In-Laws
episodes.overview: A murder investigation prompts Gibbs and the team to play family counselor to his former mentor, Mike Franks, in the hopes of preventing a bloody international conflict.

episodes.name: Endgame
episodes.overview: With the team's help, Vance faces his demons while uncovering a complex relationship with a killer that puts his whole family in danger.

episodes.name: Power Down
episodes.overview: The team literally finds themselves in the dark when the investigation into the death of a Lieutenant is connected to a city-wide blackout.

episodes.name: Child's Play
episodes.overview: A dead Marine's day job at a government think tank leads Gibbs and the team into the life of a 12-year-old prodigy who may be the killer's next target.

episodes.name: Faith
episodes.overview: The body of the son of a retired Colonel-turned-preacher is found and the team have their suspicions that he may be the victim of a hate crime.

episodes.name: Ignition
episodes.overview: When a Navy pilot is found dead under strange circumstances in a secluded area, the team finds themselves battling a no-nonsense attorney with a hidden agenda.

episodes.name: Flesh and Blood
episodes.overview: Gibbs is worried about Tony's ability to handle his job when Tony's father turns out to be linked to their newest investigation, an assassination attempt on a foreign prince.

episodes.name: Jet Lag
episodes.overview: While on the flight back from Paris, Tony and Ziva realize that their assignment to protect a government witness in an embezzlement case is in great danger when they learn that an assassin is located on the same flight.

episodes.name: Masquerade
episodes.overview: The team finds themselves in a race against time when a terrorist group threatens to detonate a "dirty bomb" in the D.C. area.

episodes.name: Jack-Knife
episodes.overview: When a Marine is found dead, Gibbs, Fornell, and the team hit the open road to bust an illegal trucking operation.

episodes.name: Mother's Day
episodes.overview: Secrets arise when Gibbs' former mother-in-law surfaces as a witness in a murder investigation.

episodes.name: Double Identity
episodes.overview: Gibbs and the team investigate the shooting of a Marine and uncovers more to his life than anyone would have ever imagined.

episodes.name: Jurisdiction
episodes.overview: The team discovers striking similarities between themselves and their CGIS (Coast Guard Investigative Services) counterparts when a Navy diver seeking sunken treasure is found dead.

episodes.name: Guilty Pleasure
episodes.overview: The death of a Navy officer leads Gibbs and the team into the world of high-priced call girls, relying on D.C. Madam Holly Snow to help them catch a killer.

episodes.name: Moonlighting
episodes.overview: When an NCIS polygraph specialist's night job takes a dangerous turn, Gibbs, Fornell, and the team have to uncover the truth.

episodes.name: Obsession
episodes.overview: DiNozzo finds himself increasingly captivated by a woman he's never met while investigating the murder of her brother.

episodes.name: Borderland
episodes.overview: The team tries to track down a serial killer, while Abby heads south of the border to give a speech with McGee in tow.

episodes.name: Patriot Down
episodes.overview: When a colleague's murder sends shockwaves through the team, Gibbs uncovers a surprising link to the crime.

episodes.name: Rule Fifty-One
episodes.overview: Gibbs heads to Mexico to face his demons and make a startling decision.
